_comment: One row per thing you can import or run. scripts/stack.py renders pydevices/docs/stack.md from this and fails when a repository holds something not listed here.

entries.name: OmniPython firmware
entries.does: Build MicroPython-compatible and CircuitPython-compatible firmware with the C modules below compiled in, for boards, desktops and the browser.

entries.name: mpftp
entries.does: Move files, run code, open the REPL, install packages and flash firmware, from VS Code, a browser tab or a terminal.

entries.name: Workbench
entries.does: Edit and run MicroPython in a browser, in a built-in simulator or on a real board over USB, Bluetooth or WebREPL.

entries.name: Board configs
entries.does: Describe one board's display, touch, audio and pins, so a program runs on it unchanged. There is one per board.

entries.name: boarddev
entries.does: Bring up a board's extra devices, such as its camera or sensors, only when you ask for them.

entries.name: displaydev
entries.does: Drive any display with one API, from an SPI panel on a board to a window on a desktop.

entries.name: displayif
entries.does: Reach display hardware from C: the I80, QSPI, MIPI DSI and RGB panel buses that `displaydev` sits on.

entries.name: pygraphics
entries.does: Draw shapes, text and images into a framebuffer.

entries.name: palettes
entries.does: Turn a palette index into a color your display can show.

entries.name: pdwidgets
entries.does: Build a user interface from labels, buttons and other small widgets, without LVGL.

entries.name: lvgl
entries.does: Use LVGL from Python with the same `import lvgl as lv` everywhere.

entries.name: fs_driver
entries.does: Let LVGL read files through Python.

entries.name: display_driver
entries.does: Connect LVGL to your board's display, input and event loop by importing one module.

entries.name: controlkit
entries.does: Add knobs, sliders, meters, lamp buttons, pad grids and a dot-matrix display to an LVGL screen.

entries.name: spectrum
entries.does: Show a spectrum analyzer in part of the screen, sharing the panel with LVGL.

entries.name: jpegio
entries.does: Decode and encode JPEG, with CircuitPython's `JpegDecoder` API.

entries.name: jpegio for CPython
entries.does: Use the `jpegio` API on a desktop.

entries.name: pngio
entries.does: Turn an RGB565 framebuffer into a PNG and back.

entries.name: pngio for CPython
entries.does: Use the `pngio` API on a desktop, over Pillow.

entries.name: ppa
entries.does: Scale, rotate, mirror, crop, convert, fill and blend pictures in memory, in hardware on an ESP32-P4.

entries.name: frame_recorder
entries.does: Record a desktop display to video.

entries.name: appdev
entries.does: Get a main loop that gathers input, runs timers and refreshes the display.

entries.name: multimer
entries.does: Use one `machine.Timer`-shaped timer and one clock on every interpreter.

entries.name: events
entries.does: Handle input as SDL2 and PyGame-style event types.

entries.name: keys
entries.does: Name keys with SDL-style key codes and modifier masks.

entries.name: backends
entries.does: Add a display or audio backend of your own, so the automatic choosers can pick it.

entries.name: appkit
entries.does: Run several apps in one program, switch between them, and get each app's memory back when it closes.

entries.name: applibs
entries.does: Install every shared app library at once.

entries.name: deskkit
entries.does: Put a clock and the weather on a screen on your desk, with swipes between them and the screen dark at night.
entries.runs: MP on an LVGL touch board

entries.name: touchkit
entries.does: Reuse what the apps on an ESP32-P4 touch board share: the shell, settings, clock, network and camera helpers.
entries.runs: MP on an ESP32-P4 touch board

entries.name: audiodev
entries.does: Play PCM and tones through one contract on every host.

entries.name: audioif
entries.does: Reach audio hardware from C: the platform drivers under the audio pump, with CircuitPython's `audiobusio.I2SOut` on top.

entries.name: audiocore
entries.does: Play WAV files and raw samples, as CircuitPython does.

entries.name: synthio
entries.does: Synthesize notes with envelopes, filters and LFOs, including `MidiTrack`, as CircuitPython does.

entries.name: audiomixer
entries.does: Mix several sources, as CircuitPython does.

entries.name: audiofilters
entries.does: Filter, distort and phase a sound.

entries.name: audiodelays
entries.does: Add echo, chorus, flanger, pitch shift and multi-tap delay.

entries.name: audiofreeverb
entries.does: Add CircuitPython's Freeverb reverb.

entries.name: audiospeed
entries.does: Change a sound's playback speed, as CircuitPython does.

entries.name: audiomp3
entries.does: Decode MP3 files, as CircuitPython does.

entries.name: audiobiquad
entries.does: Filter with biquads and all-passes whose tails reach exact zero.

entries.name: audiodynamics
entries.does: Compress, limit, expand, gate and shape transients.

entries.name: audioecho
entries.does: Add a delay with a filter, a soft-clip and a cross-feed in its feedback loop.

entries.name: audioroute
entries.does: Fan a stream out, scale stereo width, or re-point a wire while it plays.

entries.name: audioshaper
entries.does: Waveshape with a curve that is data, and sample-and-hold at an exact ratio.

entries.name: audioladder
entries.does: Filter through a transistor ladder.

entries.name: audioverb
entries.does: Build a reverberation tank whose line lengths and taps come from Python.

entries.name: audiomath
entries.does: Multiply one stream by another, and divide one down in frequency.

entries.name: audioconvolve
entries.does: Apply an impulse response by partitioned FFT.

entries.name: audiooscillator
entries.does: Read a band-limited oscillator sample by sample.

entries.name: audiomodal
entries.does: Ring a bank of resonators, for struck and plucked sounds.

entries.name: audiograph
entries.does: Render a whole patch with one C call per block.

entries.name: audiosampler
entries.does: Play recorded notes at any pitch, looped, under an envelope.

entries.name: audiometer
entries.does: Measure band levels for a spectrum meter.

entries.name: audiofeatures
entries.does: Extract speech features and detect voice, for a wake word model.

entries.name: audiovorbis
entries.does: Decode Ogg Vorbis files.

entries.name: audiopump
entries.does: Pull audio off the interpreter thread, so a slow redraw doesn't stop the sound.

entries.name: audiodsp_util
entries.does: Hold a setting at the 32-bit float a board would use, so a desktop renders the same bytes.

entries.name: audiorender
entries.does: Render a whole composition offline to a mixed stereo master and a level report.

entries.name: audioinstruments
entries.does: Play synthesizers, organs, electric pianos and drum machines, each a patch on a virtual rack.

entries.name: audioeffects
entries.does: Add compressors, EQs, reverbs, delays, modulation, drive, amp simulation and pitch shifters.

entries.name: audioairwindows
entries.does: Use Chris Johnson's Airwindows plug-ins in an audio graph.

entries.name: picotts
entries.does: Make a board with PSRAM speak, with no network and no computer.

entries.name: mpvst
entries.does: Run Python instruments and effects in your DAW as a VST3 plug-in.

entries.name: midiports
entries.does: Connect `adafruit_midi` to USB, UART, Web MIDI or a computer's own MIDI ports.

entries.name: soundmodule
entries.does: Play MIDI through a sound engine, headless from a port or through files.

entries.name: songmodel
entries.does: Edit a groovebox's song as plain data, and carry it to a front panel.

entries.name: medialink
entries.does: Send live sound and pictures between boards and computers.

entries.name: hmilink
entries.does: Use any screen as a device's front panel, over Wi-Fi, a UART, OSC or in-process.

entries.name: lite-assistant
entries.does: Chat, speak, transcribe and see through a local, OpenAI-compatible server that a board can call.

entries.name: wifi
entries.does: Use CircuitPython's `wifi.radio` API on MicroPython.

entries.name: wifi_manager
entries.does: Join a known Wi-Fi network, or ask for a new one on the screen.

entries.name: mdns
entries.does: Announce what a device offers on the network, and find what others offer, with CircuitPython's API.

entries.name: mdns for CPython
entries.does: Use the `mdns` API on a desktop, over python-zeroconf.

entries.name: bledev
entries.does: Write one Bluetooth LE program for a board, a laptop or a browser.

entries.name: bledev_hid
entries.does: Use `adafruit_hid` over Bluetooth LE, as a keyboard, mouse or media remote.

entries.name: sayso
entries.does: Call the Spotify Web API from a small object layer, with sign-in helpers.

entries.name: usbhost
entries.does: Provide the C host port that the `usb.core` packages use. You don't import it yourself.
entries.runs: MP on ESP32-S2, S3, P4; CP on P4

entries.name: usb-core
entries.does: Talk to USB devices from a host board, with `usb.core` and `usb.util`, in PyUSB's shape.

entries.name: usb-host-hid
entries.does: Read a keyboard or mouse plugged into the board.

entries.name: usb-host-msc
entries.does: Mount a USB flash drive.

entries.name: usb-host-cdc
entries.does: Talk to a USB serial device.

entries.name: usb-host-audio
entries.does: Play to a USB speaker or record from a USB microphone.

entries.name: usb-host-video
entries.does: Stream a USB webcam.

entries.name: usb-host-mtp
entries.does: Copy photos and files off a phone or camera over MTP.

entries.name: usb-host-net
entries.does: Get internet through a phone's USB tethering.

entries.name: usb-device-audio
entries.does: Make the board a USB sound card.

entries.name: usb-device-video
entries.does: Make the board a USB webcam.

entries.name: usb-device-msc
entries.does: Make the board a USB drive, from any block device.

entries.name: usb-hid
entries.does: Use CircuitPython's `usb_hid` on MicroPython, so `adafruit_hid` can type and move the mouse.

entries.name: cameraif
entries.does: Use a MIPI-CSI camera as a Python object, with its sensor found by probing.

entries.name: h264enc
entries.does: Encode RGB565 frames as H.264 in hardware.

entries.name: tsmux
entries.does: Wrap H.264 in MPEG-TS and cut it into HLS segments, so anything that plays HLS can watch a board.

entries.name: castif
entries.does: Stream what your app draws to a screen across the room.

entries.name: vision
entries.does: Run image models and handle pictures with ESP-DL, plus H.264 and RTSP on the P4.

entries.name: tflite
entries.does: Run TensorFlow Lite Micro models on a board, from speech to person detection.

entries.name: ulab
entries.does: Work with numpy-like arrays.

entries.name: Display drivers
entries.does: Drive ILI9341, ST7789, SSD1306, GC9A01 and other panels.

entries.name: Touch drivers
entries.does: Read FT6x36, GT911, CST8xx, XPT2046 and other touch panels.

entries.name: Bus drivers
entries.does: Talk over SPI, I2C, I80, CAN, RS-485 and GPIO in pure Python.

entries.name: Camera sensors

entries.name: Audio codecs
entries.does: Set up ES7210, ES8311, ES8388 and AW88298 audio chips.

entries.name: Environment sensors

entries.name: Haptics
entries.does: Buzz a DRV2605 motor driver.

entries.name: IMUs
entries.does: Read motion from BMA423, LIS3DH and QMI8658.

entries.name: Buttons and keypads
entries.does: Wire physical buttons, keypads and encoders into `appdev`.

entries.name: I/O expanders
entries.does: Add pins with CH422G, PCA9554, PI4IOE5V and XL9535.

entries.name: Joysticks
entries.does: Read a GPIO joystick.

entries.name: LEDs
entries.does: Light DotStar LEDs.

entries.name: Power
entries.does: Manage an AXP2101 PMU, or read a battery through a resistor divider.

entries.name: Radios
entries.does: Use an SX1262 radio.

entries.name: Real-time clocks
entries.does: Keep time with a PCF8563.

entries.name: Storage
entries.does: Read SD cards on an nRF52.
